theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: XEG.TO scores highest (1.612) and clears the validated absolute-trend gate, with the strongest durability bar (0.68) and highest breadth (0.786) in the eligible set. The crowding flag (z=1.04, crowded=true) is a size-down caution only, not a fade; the trend-gate leg is the only validated edge and it is supportive here, so the lean is a mild extension of the prevailing leadership rather than a momentum forecast.
evidence: gate_helps=true; theme is eligible under the trend gate
theses.dissent: Oil & Gas Producers has the highest crowding_z (1.04) and the momentum rank itself has near-zero forward edge, so the leader could simply be the last leg of an energy bid before a mean-reverting shake-out — the breadth is wide enough to be self-reinforcing but that cuts both ways if crude supply news turns.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO lags the S&P/TSX benchmark by more than 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners (XGD.TO) is the designated challenger (score 1.11) and is eligible under the trend gate with no crowding pressure (z=0.2). Durability (0.48) is moderate but weaker than the leader, and breadth (0.267) is narrow, which tempers confidence. The lean is a tilt toward the second theme in the rotation structure, not a handoff call.
theses.dissent: Breadth of only 0.267 means the rally is narrow and fragile — the challenger label is coincident and rotation timing has no validated forward edge, so gold miners may fade quickly without broad participation if risk appetite rotates back to banks or oil.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO falls below its 20-day trailing return of the S&P/TSX benchmark before the check-by date

theses.subject: Pipelines & Midstream
theses.thesis: Pipelines & Midstream is eligible (rank 6, score 0.14) with a high durability bar (0.68) matching the leader, a trend hurst tag, and meaningful breadth (0.375), uncrowded (z=0.51). As an unscorable theme (no ETF proxy), it cannot be directly graded, so conviction is capped at low, but the trend-gate leg and durability texture support a mild positive lean within the energy complex.
theses.dissent: No scorable proxy means the thesis is untestable in this format, and the same energy-complex crowding that marks Oil & Gas could spill over into midstream if the entire group corrects.
